strategy.summary: Repeat the left orbit from the right flipper and tube ramp from the left, build the left saucer, qualify two three-hit saucer sets, then use Multiball to light the 1,000-point spinner.

quickInfo.name: Left saucer
quickInfo.summary: Tube-ramp collects raise the saucer from 5,000 to 90,000, where it remains.

quickInfo.name: Ball lock
quickInfo.summary: Three top-saucer hits light the lock at the left saucer through the tube ramp.

quickInfo.name: Multiball
quickInfo.summary: After a ball is locked, three more top-saucer hits start Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Lit spinner
quickInfo.summary: During Multiball, three top-saucer hits light the spinner for 1,000 per spin and the outlanes for 50,000.

quickInfo.name: Super Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Reaching 20,000 retains that bonus floor, and reaching 40,000 retains the higher floor.

steps.text: Use the plunge and right flipper to send the ball to the top saucer.
From the right flipper, repeat the left orbit for safe top access.
Hit the top saucer three times to light Lock.
From the left flipper, shoot the tube ramp into the left saucer to lock the ball.
Hit the top saucer three more times to start Multiball.
During Multiball, repeat the top-saucer set to light the 1,000-point spinner, then rip the spinner while extra balls remain.
After Multiball, repeat the left orbit and built tube-ramp saucer route.

fallback.title: Left-orbit control
fallback.when: Use this when the tube-ramp saucer kickout is unsafe.

steps.text: Delay the ramp and lock.
Repeat the left orbit from the right flipper.
Use safe top-saucer and upper-rollover contacts for progress.
Return to the tube ramp only when Multiball protection or a safe kickout makes the risk acceptable.

alternatives.title: Bank and bonus route
alternatives.when: Use this when upper rollovers spot bank targets and the orbits are unreliable.

steps.text: Use upper rollovers to spot targets without direct bank rebounds.
Complete the bank once for 2x bonus and again for 4x bonus.
Take later bank awards only when the target return remains safe.

alternatives.title: Built 90,000 saucer
alternatives.when: Use this when the tube ramp and saucer kickout are repeatable.

steps.text: Repeat the tube ramp to raise the left-saucer value by 5,000 per collect.
Reach 90,000 and continue the ramp only while its return stays controlled.

buildsToward.title: Multiball, 1,000-point spinner, and retained Super Bonus

steps.text: Complete the first three-hit top-saucer set and lock a ball.
Complete the second three-hit set to start Multiball.
Complete another saucer set during Multiball to light the spinner.
Rip the lit spinner while protected.

techniques.name: Two-flipper orbit loop
techniques.instruction: Shoot the left orbit from the right flipper, then shoot the tube ramp from the left flipper after the return is controlled.

cautions.issue: The left-saucer kickout can be uncontrolled and can erase the value of a safe ramp repeat.
cautions.response: Test the kickout once and delay tube shots until Multiball if it does not return safely.

cautions.issue: Pop-bumper exits and direct drop-target rebounds can send the ball toward a drain.
cautions.response: Prefer orbit access and upper rollovers that spot targets over direct bank shots.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Bally Xenon production rules and ball count.
Test tube ramp, top saucer, lock qualification, and saucer eject.
strategy.simpleOverview: Xenon uses repeated top-saucer sets to light a lock, start Multiball, and then light its high-value spinner. Repeat the left orbit and tube ramp, complete two three-hit saucer sets for Multiball, then complete another set during Multiball before ripping the lit spinner.
strategy.overview: Xenon uses repeated top-saucer sets to light a lock, start Multiball, and then light its high-value spinner. Use the first cycle to light and take the lock, the second to start Multiball, and a third during Multiball to light the 1,000-per-spin spinner and 50,000 outlanes. Build the left-saucer value along the way and reach the 20,000 and 40,000 Super Bonus floors.
